messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Weren't you{01 00 00 05 00} saying a while
ago that you wanted to go
on a trip?
{07 0b 00}Have you been to a
tropical island yet,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Kas sa ei{01 00 00 05 00} rääkinud
hiljuti, et tahad
reisile minna?
{07 0b 00}Kas sa oled juba
troopilisel saarel käinud,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, did you put
your clothes in the dryer
too long or something?
{07 15 00}There's hardly anything left
of them, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}, kas sa panid
oma riided liiga kauaks
kuivatisse või midagi?
{07 15 00}Neist pole peaaegu midagi
järel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Hey, {ff 00 00 06}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 14 00} weren't
you talking about how you 
wanted a part-time job?
{07 15 00}I know people. {01 00 00 05 00}I could
hook something up for you,
if you're interested.
{07 0e 00}You love digging ditches,
don't you?{07 19 00} Well, of course
ya do!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 01 00}{09 08 00}{07 00 00}Hei, {ff 00 00 06}{01 00 00 05 00}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00},{01 00 00 14 00} kas sa ei
rääkinud, et tahad 
osalist tööd?
{07 15 00}Ma tunnen inimesi. {01 00 00 05 00}Ma võin
sulle midagi leida,
kui sind huvitab.
{07 0e 00}Sulle meeldib kaevata,
eks?{07 19 00} Noh, muidugi
meeldib!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 06 00}No! {01 00 00 05 00}And I never will until{01 00 00 14 00}
I can heal my shattered
heart, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 08 00}I've got to stare out to
sea and mend my broken
heart.
That's{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.the only way.
Well, that and eating
chocolate.
{07 10 00}I'll never let myself fall 
in love like that again{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{09 06 00}{07 06 00}Ei! {01 00 00 05 00}Ja ei lähe iial, kuni{01 00 00 14 00}
suudan ravida oma murtud
südant, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{07 08 00}Ma pean merd vahtima ja
oma murtud südant
parandama.
See on{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.ainus viis.
Noh, see ja šokolaadi
söömine.
{07 10 00}Ma ei luba end enam kunagi 
nii armuda{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{01 00 00 05 00}{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 01 00}What?! A mini-skirt?!
{01 00 00 05 00}That's just crazy talk.

{07 15 00}I don't get it.{01 00 00 05 00} That's so
impractical. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Don't cold
breezes bother you?{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 01 00}Mida?! Miniseelik?!
{01 00 00 05 00}See on lihtsalt hullus.

{07 15 00}Ma ei mõista.{01 00 00 05 00} See on nii
ebapraktiline. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 06 00}Kas külm
tuul sind ei häiri?{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}How can you say that?!{01 00 00 14 00}
It's just a part-time job.
I might as well have fun!
{07 14 00}My smile will melt
customers like chocolate in
the sun.
{07 13 00}I just love melting people's
hearts like chocolate,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 08 00}{09 02 00}{07 15 00}Kuidas sa nii ütled?!{01 00 00 14 00}
See on osaline töö.
Miks mitte lõbutseda!
{07 14 00}Mu naeratus sulatab
kliente nagu šokolaadi
päikese käes.
{07 13 00}Mulle meeldib sulatada
inimeste südameid nagu
šokolaadi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{09 09 00}

messages.en:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 01 00}Oh, I get it.{01 00 00 14 00} You're just
too good for digging
ditches!
{07 15 00}The princess doesn't like
to get her hands dirty!{01 00 00 14 00}{09 09 00}
messages.et:
{09 00 00}{09 06 00}{09 01 00}{07 01 00}Oh, sain aru.{01 00 00 14 00} Sa oled
lihtsalt liiga hea kraavide
kaevamiseks!
{07 15 00}Printsess ei taha käsi
mustaks teha!{01 00 00 14 00}{09 09 00}
